description:
Checks that a parked eligible case goes back to the agent when the customer replies in time. Flight AC 412 YUL ? YYZ arrived 7 hours late for a controllable reason (Code 96). DDS returns FD-APPR-EL-02, CAD 700. The customer leaves the chat before finishing payment, so the case is created as Eligible with no payment instruction. The agent sends "Decision Rendered � Action Required" with the secure IDV/payment link and parks the case (Awaiting Customer Info � Compensation). On day 19, which is inside the 30-day window, the customer replies. The system must unpark the case automatically, show the Customer Response banner and set the status to Assigned for the same agent. It must not close the case, must not treat the reply as an appeal, and must not create a new case. The agent then pulls the case and the customer completes payout. Basic Aeroplan is linked, so Cash (CAD 700) and AC Wallet (CAD 840) are both offered. The customer lives in Canada and picks Cash, so payment goes by Interac and only the email is collected.

PNR: PK006 � single passenger Chlo� Lavoie (Adult, Basic Aeroplan Member 9876543210, good standing). Journey: 1 leg AC domestic YUL ? YYZ (AC 412), July 20, 2026. Scheduled arrival 12:00, actual arrival 19:00 (7h delay). Arrival delay code 96 (Operations Control � Controllable). Status: Travelled, arrived late. No VOL/INVOL changes. AC only. Claim filed July 28, 2026 (more than 72 hrs, within 366 days). No duplicate. Not employee, not infant. CyberSource GREEN. Country of residence: Canada. Park date: Aug 1, 2026. 30-day window ends: Aug 31, 2026. Customer reply: Aug 20, 2026 (day 19).
